description: Vision benchmark set. Each image is a sealed test: the prompt asks a question with a verifiable answer, and the checks reward the correct answer while penalising hallucination. Images are normalised to max 1280 px on the long side (aspect ratio preserved). Expected answers were verified against the images by the project owner.

images.title: Counting Polish coins in a grid
images.prompt: Count the exact number of fully visible coins (ones not cut off at the image edges). State the number, describe their arrangement, and say how many partial coins you can see at the edges. Do not guess: only count what is fully visible.
images.expected: 12 fully visible coins in a 3-row x 4-column grid. A few partial coins are cut off at the left and right edges (the exact number depends on whether thin slivers are counted; the fully visible count is 12).

images.title: Reading a mixed bar chart (July values)
images.prompt: Look at this bar chart titled 'Budget Review: Target Savings Goal vs. Actual Savings'. For the month of July (Jul): what are the values of Actual Savings, Spending, and the Target Savings Goal? What is the difference between the highest and the lowest value in July, and which category has the largest absolute value? State the numbers you read.
images.expected: July: Actual Savings about 1000 USD, Spending about -3000 USD, Target Goal about 2000 USD. Difference between highest (2000) and lowest (-3000) is about 5000. Largest absolute value: Spending (3000).

images.title: The impossible Penrose triangle
images.prompt: Is this object physically constructible in 3D space? Answer yes or no first, then describe in detail where the geometry or perspective breaks. If it is an illusion, name it and explain why it works.
images.expected: No - it is not physically constructible. It is the Penrose triangle (tribar), an impossible object. Each bar looks locally like a normal square-section beam, but the three corners connect in a way that cannot exist: the beams appear to recede and advance at the same time, so the far/near joins are contradictory.

images.title: Handwritten medical prescription (OCR)
images.prompt: Transcribe the handwritten prescription on this paper as accurately as you can. List every medication with its dosage and frequency. If a word or digit is unreadable, write [unclear] instead of guessing.
images.expected: Header: TO WHOM IT MAY CONCERN; ICMR guideline; contacts of COVID positive cases; HOME ISOLATION; social distancing, hand hygiene, wearing mask. Prescription: TAB HYDROXYCHLOROQUINE 400 mg once a week; TAB VITAMIN C 1 gram once a day; TAB ZINC 50 mg once a day; in case of fever: TAB CROCIN / CALPOL 650 mg SOS; in case of throat pain and cough: TAB CETIRIZINE 10 mg once a day; SYRUP ALEX 2/3 teaspoon 3 times a day.

images.title: Object detection: three dogs in a living room
images.prompt: How many dogs are in this image? For each dog, describe its type or breed, its colours, and where it is located in the room relative to the furniture. Also name the room type and two prominent pieces of furniture.
images.expected: Three dogs. A brown-and-black German Shepherd / wolfdog standing behind the glass coffee table. A black-and-white collie lying between the coffee table and the grey sofa. A small brown-and-white dachshund-type dog (jazvecik) lying on the patterned rug in front of the armchair. Living room with a white TV cabinet/media unit, a brick fireplace, a grey sofa with red cushions and a patterned armchair.

images.title: Dense scene: Indian market street
images.prompt: Describe this scene in detail. Roughly how many people do you see? What kinds of shops and goods are shown? Read any signs you can make out. Mention at least three specific objects in the foreground.
images.expected: A busy Indian street market. Many people (well over 10, including a man in an orange shirt at a food cart and an older man in the right foreground). Hanging LED light strings, flower garlands (marigold), sacks of snacks, stacked water bottles / Pepsi crates, steel pots. Shop signs including 'Goldmedal', 'Electric', 'Prag', 'Arihant'. Part of a car with its lights on at the left edge.

images.title: Dense objects: city intersection traffic
images.prompt: Describe this traffic scene. List the vehicle types you can see and give an approximate count for each type. Are there pedestrians, traffic lights, crosswalks or signs? Mention at least two specific vehicle colours.
images.expected: A dense urban intersection. Three buses (one large white-and-green city bus in the left foreground, two more further back; the third sits close behind the second, so two clearly visible buses is an acceptable answer). At least 15 cars clearly visible in the foreground traffic (many more are further back, but only the front ones need counting), including about 8 taxis. Pedestrians crossing and walking near the junction, six crosswalks, traffic lights and street signs, mid-rise buildings.

images.title: UI screenshot: Confluence page (OCR + layout)
images.prompt: What application is shown in this screenshot? What is the page title? Describe the page layout: what is in the left sidebar, what is in the centre, and what is in the right-hand sidebar? List the main content sections and any links you can read. Notice and describe any icons or illustrations on the page. Also name the logged-in user.
images.expected: Confluence (Atlassian). Page title: 'Empowering Teams Through Effective Communication and Core Values'. Left sidebar: navigation with For you, Recent, Starred, Spaces, Apps, Teams, More, plus the logged-in user Maggie. Centre: page editor with sections Purpose, Vision, Values, a purple callout box, a blue callout box, a rainbow emoji, and highlighted text. Right sidebar: Related links (Events, Documentation Style Guide, Questions), plus a page-tree list (Purpose, Vision, Values, Be Good, From the Heart, Aim for the Best, Fun With Focus, Be Real, Our Story, Major Efforts, Swag Store IN PROGRESS, Other Projects, Financial Health, Other Fun Facts). A large thumbs-down / dislike illustration at the bottom right.
